summary: @servicetitan/line-item-editor preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that, when a local `bun` binary is absent, downloads Bun v1.3.13 from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temporary directory, sets it executable, and uses that freshly downloaded runtime to execute a shipped 727KB Bun-tagged sibling script `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is heavily obfuscated (Bun-cjs header, rotated string-array with a shift-rotator function and a ~1200-entry mixed literal decoder table), so its actual behavior is not observable without executing it. Running an opaque payload under an alien language runtime pulled at `npm install` time places arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine outside Node-based tooling visibility. The stated identity of the package is a React `line-item-editor` UI component library under the @servicetitan scope, which has no functional need for a second language runtime or an obfuscated Bun bundle at install time; the shipped install-time behavior is inconsistent with that stated purpose and is characteristic of a compromised or lookalike publication of the scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
